NOTE: Virus Research Institute Inc said its net income (loss) per common share and shares used in computing net income (loss) per common share for the three and six months ended June 30, 1996 are presented on a pro forma basis and are based on the weighted average number of common shares outstanding during the period presented and reflect the automatic conversion of all preferred stock then outstanding into common stock.
Revenues in the second quarter of 1997 decreased primarily due to milestone payments in the company's collaboration with Pasteur Merieux Connaught received during the second quarter of 1996.
